title: Do Not Sell the Pair
setup: Black's knight has jumped to a5 to swap itself for your light-squared bishop. Keep the bishop pair.
hint: The knight on a5 has asked a question. Price your bishop by what it will be worth in six moves, not this one.
explanation:
## The Idea

Two bishops cover every square on the board; one covers half of it. Strong players price the pair at about half a pawn and spend real moves keeping it.

{{Bc2}} steps out of reach and keeps both bishops. The other retreats fail: c4 is still in the knight's reach, and a4 hangs to the b-pawn. Black gets on with {{c5}}, and White opens the center with {{d4}}.

Standing still invites {{Nxb3}}, which hands Black the pair, doubles White's b-pawns and opens the a-file in one move.
